arabic text:
Pul pe baghdad ke hai janaza rakha
khoon aankhon se pani bahate hue
hatkadi bediyan tauq pehne hue
qaid sajjad ki yaad karta hua
english translation text:
Upon Baghdad's bridge lies a funeral bier,
with blood and tears flowing from the eyes;
wearing handcuffs, shackles and a heavy collar,
remembering Sajjad's captivity.

arabic text: jiske athara bete jawan saal ke\nuski mayyat ko mazdoor lekar chale\nbain karti chali saath may sayyeda
english translation text: He who had eighteen young sons—\nhired labourers carried his body,\nwhile the Sayyida walked beside it reciting lament.

arabic text: ajnabi shehr hai door ahle watan\ntere baba ko de kaun ghusl-o-kafan\naao jaldi watan s imame raza
english translation text: This is a foreign city, far from your homeland.\nWho will give your father the ritual washing and shroud?\nCome quickly from your homeland, O Imam Raza.

arabic text: sabr karna hai sughra ke jaisa tujhe\nraasta dekhna baap ka chor de\njaake masoom-e-qum se kehde hawa
english translation text: You must show patience like Sughra;\nstop waiting for your father to return.\nO wind, go and tell the innocent lady of Qum.

arabic text: qaid may chal basa shahe kaun-o-makan\nab to mazloom ki khol do bediyan, tumne chaha tha jo lo wohi\nhogaya
english translation text: The King of all creation died within prison.\nNow open the oppressed one's shackles;\nwhat you desired has come to pass.

arabic text: laash par bhi nahi rone wala koi\nwarise deen ki haye bewaarsi, dhoonti hai khaza dafn karne ki jaa
english translation text: No one even remains to weep over the body. Alas, the heir\nof the faith lies abandoned; destiny searches for a place to bury him.

arabic text: bayn karte takkalum sabhi aa gaye\nkarbala se madine se aur sham se, chauda barson ka qaidi reha\nhogaya
english translation text: O Taqallum, all arrived reciting lament:\nfrom Karbala, Madina and Shaam.\nThe prisoner of fourteen years was finally released.
